name: Let Me Eat 2: Feeding Madness 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Let Me Eat 2: Feeding Madness is an arcade game where you have to control several fast-growing marine predators who are out to uncover a mystery lurking in the ocean. The aim of the game is to avoid predators and obstacles while eating other smaller fish and creatures, eventually reaching the top of the food chain.
